title: Have electrical wiring work done only by qualified people
what: Have electrical wiring work done only by qualified supervisors, or by holders of a tradesperson certificate working under a qualified supervisor's supervision.

sources.title: Home Building Act 1989 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An individual must not do any electrical wiring work (whether or not it is also residential building work), except— (a) as a qualified supervisor in respect of that work, or (b) as the holder of a tradesperson certificate authorising its holder to do that work under supervision

administration.who: Building Commission NSW (Secretary of the Department of Customer Service)
